title: Is risk management one of the better uses for AI in trading?
author: SmoothString3369
selftext: There is a lot of attention around AI finding setups and predicting where price might go, but I think the less exciting uses may actually be more useful. Things like position sizing, calculating risk, checking drawdown and testing different scenarios are areas where an AI tool can save time without necessarily making the trading decision for you. The aifo ai coach takes this approach with calculators for position sizing, risk management and drawdown rather than giving specific buy or sell instructions. Do you think AI is more useful as a risk-management assistant than as a signal generator?
